written: 2026-11-26 P0, before any GPU inference or teacher query

bundle.sampler: scratch_all s0, S1 n_z 64, top-6 -> top-4, proposal seed 0

rule.note: same production rule for every arm; NOT equally calibrated thresholds for different events

readouts.Y: pY(endpoint), one shared value per canonical assignment
readouts.noop: pY(empty) for every arm (gate and competing no-op)
readouts.rank_only: argmax nonempty repair per readout: no gate, eta 0, no no-op

pool: exhaustive.stream(exhaustive.proposals(root, sampler, 0), 4): all legal ordered K1-K3 sequences of the top-4 sets, streamed once, chunk 8192

roster.denominator: 150 K1-K3 per domain; K0 30 / NONE 30 safeguards

panel.per_domain: 10 m=2 + 10 m=3 legacy-witness endpoints, <=1 per root, families first

labels.3d: resolution EVALUATED -> stored value (0 = teacher-budget-defined failure, not impossibility); UNRESOLVED_* -> UNKNOWN
labels.join: X by exact ordered sequence, Y by canonical endpoint; decided conflicts quarantined
labels.Z: 1 iff X=Y=1; 0 iff a factor decided 0; else UNKNOWN; NOOP/ABSTAIN on K1-K3 unsuccessful

tiers: T1 primary J/X/Y top-1 on K1-K3 (whole roots, sha256 XYO_Q|root order) <=320
T4 rank-only + XC picks from remaining capacity

statistics.metric: K1-K3 all-root strict verified success, equal-K-stratum weighted (mean of K1,K2,K3 rates)
statistics.ci: family-cluster bootstrap, 4000 draws seed 0, whole families resampled (no split across strata), stratum weights recomputed per replicate
statistics.p_value: paired family-level sign-flip randomization of arm labels, 20000 fixed-seed (0) permutations, plus-one correction
statistics.established: Holm p<0.05 AND CI excludes 0 AND UNKNOWN<=20% in both arms AND >=90% roster evaluable
statistics.order_primary: per domain on the O-B panel: learned pX1 top-order vs canonical and vs analytic random (Holm over 4) only if >=10 mixed groups and >=10 families; else descriptive
statistics.order_mechanistic: mixed-group X+ vs X- concordance of pX1 (Y=1 groups), family-cluster CI vs 0.5
statistics.exploratory: everything else (factor diagnostics, rank-only, XC, O-A VAL groups)

dev: VAL (exposed; scorer early-stopped on it) for diagnostics only; protected TEST never opened
